test_string_unicode_conversion: test pybind11 builtin casters for utf8, utf16, utf32, and wchar string conversion and error reporting
test_integer_casting: test pybind11 integer casting with range validation for i32, u32, i64, and u64 types
test_tuple_pair_casting: test pybind11 std::pair and std::tuple conversion to and from Python tuples
test_bool_caster: test pybind11 bool caster implicit conversions for None, objects with __bool__, and numpy bool_
test_string_view_support: test pybind11 C++17 string_view argument and return value casting for utf8, utf16, and utf32
